# Icons

<Banner variant="warning" className="component-banner">

You can still use <a href="https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system-icons/releases/tag/v1.9.0">@airbus/icons v1.x</a> and upgrade later with your own <a href="#material-icons" target="_self">material icons setup</a>.

## Airbus Icons

See https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system-icons#usage

Airbus icons are listed below.
To request new icons, please [submit a feature request](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/issues/new/choose)

## Material Icons

See https://fonts.google.com/icons or [google developer guide](https://developers.google.com/fonts/docs/material_symbols) for full reference.<br />
Several approaches exist to integrate Material Icons into your project. Choose the solution that best fit your project.

### Google Fonts

Specify icon names to load only the necessary icons.

```html
<link
  href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined&icon_names=home,palette,settings&display=block"
  rel="stylesheet"
/>
```

### NPM packages

Google does not publish any official npm packages. Here is a community list :

- "Classic" Material Icons
  - [@fontsource/material-icons](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fontsource/material-icons)
  - [@material-design-icons/font](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@material-design-icons/font)
  - [@material-design-icons/svg](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@material-design-icons/svg)
- "New" Material Symbols (built on variable font technology)
  - [@fontsource-variable/material-symbols-outlined](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fontsource-variable/material-symbols-outlined)
  - [material-symbols](https://www.npmjs.com/package/material-symbols)
- React Material Icons
  - [@mui/icons-material](https://mui.com/material-ui/material-icons/), which depends on @mui/material component library
  - [svgr](https://github.com/gregberge/svgr) : convert svgs into react component at build time
  - [vite-plugin-svgr](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vite-plugin-svgr) : vite svgr plugin

### Example

The examples in this documentation are using [@material-design-icons/svg](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@material-design-icons/svg) combined with [svgr](https://github.com/gregberge/svgr)

```js
import Home from "@material-design-icons/svg/filled/home.svg?react";
import HomeOutlined from "@material-design-icons/svg/outlined/home.svg?react";
```
